placements.why: Establishes the foundational organizational strata category for instrument calibrations, operational baselines, and measurement history.
placements.title: Observatory Instrument and Measurement Calibration
placements.frame: How are instrument calibrations, baselines, and historical calibration records governed and verified?

placements.why: Captures the broader organizational directive to completely remove, forget, and disavow historical calibration claims, personnel attributions, and instrument records that are asserted to have never occurred.
placements.title: Complete Disavowal and Epistemic Purging of Disputed Calibration Baselines
placements.frame: How does the organization handle, purge, and formally disavow calibration baselines and historical claims determined to be invalid or unperformed?
